ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Bumps github/codeql-action init/autobuild/analyze from @v3 to @v4 in .github/workflows/codeql.yml and the adopt scaffolding template (shared/templates/github-actions/codeql.yml.template). Stays on a mutable GitHub-owned major-version tag per ADR-271's accepted posture (GitHub-owned actions are not SHA-pinned); only the tag's value changes, ahead of GitHub's Dec-2026 v3 deprecation and fall-2026 Node20 runner removal. No new third-party action introduced, no permission or trigger change.
